title: Parent Hover Emphasizes Window and Step Chrome
description: When hovering a window or introduction step unit, emphasize identity chrome (name/icon/drag handle) via CSS parent rules—matching tree-row hover scope—without changing leaf data-hover-scope behavior for direct chip hover.
summary: Follow-up fixed piecewise borders on chips flowing along WindowChrome silhouettes. The shared title chip primitive is intrinsically borderless, and the silhouette-chip CSS boundary now removes outer borders and inset shadows from immediate nested controls such as Button groups while preserving deliberate dividers inside multi-tab and multi-button groups. Extended the existing React appearance tests and styling contract test. Verified ui-styling 24/24, focused ui-react 2/2, and the live Aggregator introduction: name, step count, Next, and Close all compute to 0px borders, border-style none, box-shadow none, with no browser console warnings/errors. The full React quick suite remains at 470/479 with nine unrelated pre-existing failures; typecheck remains blocked by unrelated existing generated-manifest, icon, node/tree, and stale fixture errors.
